headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2021: Adam Page vs. Bryan Danielson went to battle over the AEW World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 9.53 ? an all-time classic. For Bryan Danielson, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. An instant classic, rated five stars by multiple outlets ? both men bled and threw everything they had at each other across a full 60 minutes, with Page's Buckshot Lariat landing just as time expired, an epic that ended in an unresolved draw.

On a Friday in 2023, back when Top Flight & Andretti vs. Komander, Penta & Vikingo headlined Rampage, rated 8.47 ? one of the better matches of the year in a wild trios sprint ? part of that year's Winter is Coming '23 - Night 2.
Flash back to 2023, when Ross von Erich kicked off their AEW journey, appearing on Rampage, rated 5.49.

secondaries.text: It was 2021 when Serena Deeb returned to the fold after 7 weeks away, appearing on Dynamite.

That Wednesday in 2021, MJF vs. Dante Martin fought it out with the Dynamite Diamond Ring on the line, in the night's main event on Dynamite, rated 6.17 ? part of a stacked Winter is Coming '21 card, rated 8.65 overall.
Rewind to 2023, when it was the first-ever encounter between Anna Jay and Red Velvet on Rampage, rated 4.49.
